name: Kailasa Temple (Cave 16)
description: The largest single monolithic rock excavation in the world, carved from top-down from a single basalt cliff representing Mount Kailash. This 8th-century Hindu temple stands 32m tall and took over 100 years to complete, with an estimated 200,000 tonnes of rock removed.
hi_description: दुनिया का सबसे बड़ा एकल एकश्मक शिल्प, जिसे ऊपर से नीचे तक एक ही बेसाल्ट चट्टान से काटा गया है जो माउंट कैलाश का प्रतिनिधित्व करता है। यह 8वीं सदी का मंदिर 32 मीटर ऊंचा है।

name: Vishvakarma Cave (Cave 10)
description: A large Buddhist chaitya hall carved during the 6th century with intricate sculptural details. Features stone pillars and a stupa representing Buddhist architectural mastery.
hi_description: 6वीं सदी में बना एक बड़ा बौद्ध चैत्य हॉल जिसमें पत्थर के स्तंभ और जटिल मूर्तिकला हैं।

name: Indra Sabha (Cave 32)
description: A Jain temple complex among the last structures built at Ellora, featuring multi-storey carved architecture with intricate carvings and detailed sculptural work representing Jain religious beliefs.
hi_description: एलोरा में अंतिम बनाए गए जैन मंदिरों में से एक, बहुमंजिला नक्काशीदार वास्तुकला के साथ।

name: Rameshvara Cave (Cave 21)
description: Possibly the oldest Hindu cave at Ellora from the late 500s, containing some of the most beautiful carvings on its pillars and walls dedicated to Shiva and Hindu deities.
hi_description: 6वीं सदी का एलोरा का सबसे पुराना हिंदू गुफा, जिसमें शिव को समर्पित सुंदर मूर्तिकला है।

name: Grishneshwar Temple
description: An active Jyotirlinga shrine located adjacent to the Ellora complex, dedicated to Shiva. One of the 12 revered Jyotirlinga temples in India, built in traditional Hindu temple architecture.
hi_description: भारत के 12 प्रसिद्ध ज्योतिर्लिंग मंदिरों में से एक, शिव को समर्पित।

name: Swayambhu Ganpati Temple
description: A 400-year-old temple with a naturally-formed Ganesh idol believed to be self-manifested. One of few temples in India where the deity faces west, attracting thousands of devotees to this sacred Konkan site.
hi_description: 400 साल पुराना मंदिर जहां गणेश की स्वयंभू मूर्ति है, यह मंदिर पश्चिम की ओर मुखी है।

name: Ganpatipule Beach
description: A 6km crescent-shaped white sand beach adjacent to the Ganpati Temple, one of only two white sand beaches in Maharashtra. Clean water and gentle waves make it suitable for swimming and relaxation.
hi_description: कोंकण के सबसे स्वच्छ समुद्र तटों में से एक, जहां सफेद रेत और साफ पानी है।

name: Prachin Konkan Museum
description: Museum showcasing traditional Konkan life, culture, and artwork with a collection of over 3,000 artefacts including daily-use items, handicrafts, and historical pieces reflecting regional heritage.
hi_description: कोंकण की परंपरागत जीवन शैली और संस्कृति को दर्शाने वाला संग्रहालय।

name: Jaigad Fort
description: Historical coastal fort located 25km from Ganpatipule, built during the Maratha period with strategic views of the Arabian Sea and surrounding Konkan landscape.
hi_description: 25 किमी दूर स्थित एक ऐतिहासिक तटीय किला जो मराठा काल में बना था।

name: Harihareshwar Temple
description: Ancient Peshwa-era Shiva temple built on a peninsula surrounded by the Savitri River and Arabian Sea. Features stone carvings and overlooks crashing waves from dramatic black basalt cliffs.
hi_description: पेशवा काल में बना शिव मंदिर जो सावित्री नदी और अरब सागर से घिरा है।

name: Kalbhairav Temple
description: Ancient temple dedicated to Kalbhairav, a fierce form of Shiva, traditionally visited before the main Harihareshwar temple. Located with views of the Savitri River confluence.
hi_description: शिव के भयंकर रूप को समर्पित प्राचीन मंदिर।

name: Harihareshwar Beach
description: Dramatic black basalt beach with tide pools and rocky formations, surrounded by four hills forming a natural amphitheater. Strong currents make swimming unsafe; best for walking and photography at low tide.
hi_description: काले बेसाल्ट की चट्टानों से बनाया गया नाटकीय समुद्र तट।

name: Ganesh Galli
description: A narrow 3-foot passage between two rocky mountains with a large idol of Ganesh said to emerge during low tides, creating a sacred and unique natural phenomenon.
hi_description: दो पहाड़ों के बीच 3 फीट का संकीर्ण रास्ता जहां गणेश की मूर्ति समुद्र के सूखने पर दिखाई देती है।

name: Kalsubai Peak
description: Maharashtra's highest peak at 1,646m with a 3-hour trek from Baari village via rocky outcrops and three iron ladders on vertical slopes. Best visited September-February for clear summit views and sunrise treks.
hi_description: महाराष्ट्र की सबसे ऊंची चोटी जहां से पूरे सह्याद्री पर्वत श्रृंखला का दृश्य दिखता है।

name: Arthur Lake
description: A serene mountain lake surrounded by the Sahyadri hills, offering views of nearby forts like Harishchandragad and Ratangad from the elevated shoreline. Best visited during monsoon when water levels are high.
hi_description: सह्याद्री पहाड़ों से घिरी एक शांत झील जहां पास के किलों का दृश्य दिखता है।

name: Vipassana International Academy
description: Global meditation center offering 10-day silent vipassana retreats. The Golden Pagoda is a striking architectural landmark visible from town, representing an important Buddhist practice center.
hi_description: ध्यान साधना के लिए एक अंतर्राष्ट्रीय केंद्र जहां 10 दिन के मौन विपश्यना पाठ्यक्रम चलते हैं।

name: Amruteshwar Temple
description: A 1,200-year-old Shiva temple in Hemadpanthi architectural style located in Ratanwadi village. Features beautiful rock carvings and intricate stone work representing ancient Hindu temple design.
hi_description: 1,200 साल पुराना शिव मंदिर हेमाड़पंथी शैली में निर्मित है।

name: Randha Falls
description: A cascading waterfall on the Rajur-Bhandardara road where the Pravara River drops in white streams from cliff edges. Most dramatic during monsoon season when water volume is highest.
hi_description: प्रवरा नदी पर बना झरना जो मानसून में बहुत शक्तिशाली होता है।

name: Cave 3 (Chaitya Hall)
description: A large 26m Buddhist chaitya hall with twin Buddha figures and stone pillars, representing the finest example of Hinayana Buddhist architecture within the Kanheri complex.
hi_description: एक बड़ा बौद्ध चैत्य हॉल जिसमें दो बुद्ध की मूर्तियां हैं।

name: Ancient Water Management System
description: Rock-cut channels carved above the caves that fed monsoon rainwater into underground cisterns, providing a sophisticated water supply system for the monastic community.
hi_description: गुफाओं के ऊपर बने चैनल जो बारिश के पानी को भूमिगत टंकियों में जमा करते थे।

name: Stupa and Congregation Hall
description: Buddhist pagoda (stupa) within a congregation hall surrounded by massive stone pillars, demonstrating the scale and organization of the monastic establishment at Kanheri.
hi_description: बौद्ध स्तूप और एक विशाल पत्थर के स्तंभों वाला सभा हॉल।

name: Karla Chaitya Hall
description: The largest preserved Buddhist chaitya hall in India at 45m long and 14m high, featuring 37 octagonal pillars. Built in the 2nd century BCE as part of an important early Hinayana monastic complex.
hi_description: भारत का सबसे बड़ा संरक्षित बौद्ध चैत्य हॉल, 45 मीटर लंबा और 37 अष्टभुजाकार स्तंभ वाला।

name: Bhaja Cave Complex
description: A 22-cave Buddhist monastery complex dating to the 2nd century BCE, 3km from Karla. Features the earliest surviving chaitya hall with apsidal hall design and stupa cluster, simpler and older than Karla caves.
hi_description: 22 गुफाओं का बौद्ध मठ परिसर, 2वीं सदी ईसा पूर्व का, जिसमें सबसे पुराना चैत्य हॉल है।

name: Ekvira Temple
description: A Hindu temple near the Karla Caves complex dedicated to Goddess Ekvira, combining ancient and medieval architecture. Located within walking distance of the Buddhist cave sites.
hi_description: देवी एक्वीरा को समर्पित एक हिंदू मंदिर जो कार्ला गुफाओं के पास है।

name: Kashid Beach
description: A 3km stretch of white sand beach backed by casuarina trees, one of only two white sand beaches in Maharashtra. Clean water, calm waves, and minimal development make it ideal for swimming and relaxation.
hi_description: महाराष्ट्र के सबसे स्वच्छ और सफेद रेत वाले समुद्र तटों में से एक।

name: Murud Janjira Fort
description: A 15th-century offshore fort built under Malik Amber's rule, accessible by boat from Rajapuri jetty. Known for its historic architecture and strategic island location in the Arabian Sea.
hi_description: 15वीं सदी का एक द्वीप किला जो समुद्र के बीच में है, नाव से पहुंचा जा सकता है।

name: Phansad Wildlife Sanctuary
description: A biodiverse wildlife sanctuary located 30km from Kashid, home to varied bird species, migratory birds, and diverse flora. Ideal for nature walks and bird watching during winter months.
hi_description: एक वन्यजीव अभयारण्य जहां विभिन्न प्रकार के पक्षी और जानवर मिलते हैं।

name: Revdanda Fort
description: Ruins of a Portuguese fort located 15km from Kashid, offering quieter beach ambiance and historical significance from the colonial period. Known for sunset photography and isolated coastal charm.
hi_description: एक पुर्तगाली किले के अवशेष जो शांत और ऐतिहासिक समुद्र तट पर हैं।
